entities.name: Charles-François Dupuis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles François Dupuis was a French savant, a professor of rhetoric at the Collège de Lisieux, Paris, who studied for the law in his spare time and was received as avocat in 1770. He also served on the committee that developed the French Republican Calendar.
